title: Detailed fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <rect x="8" y="82" width="84" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1a4a1a"/>
  
  <!-- Ladder -->
  <rect x="30" y="18" width="58" height="4" rx="1" fill="#c0c0c0"/>
  <rect x="30" y="22" width="58" height="2" fill="#a0a0a0"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="18" x2="38" y2="24" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="18" x2="48" y2="24" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="18" x2="58" y2="24" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="18" x2="68" y2="24" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="18" x2="78" y2="24" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Ladder base mount -->
  <rect x="36" y="24" width="12" height="6" rx="1" fill="#909090"/>
  
  <!-- Hose coil on top -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="22" r="6" fill="#e8c020"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="22" r="3" fill="#c0a010"/>
  
  <!-- Main body -->
  <rect x="12" y="34" width="76" height="44" rx="3" fill="#e02020"/>
  
  <!-- Cab front section -->
  <rect x="60" y="34" width="28" height="44" rx="3" fill="#d81818"/>
  
  <!-- Cab roof -->
  <rect x="62" y="30" width="24" height="6" rx="2" fill="#c01010"/>
  
  <!-- Windshield -->
  <rect x="64" y="38" width="20" height="14" rx="2" fill="#60c8f0"/>
  <rect x="64" y="38" width="20" height="6" rx="2" fill="#80d8ff"/>
  
  <!-- Side window -->
  <rect x="48" y="38" width="10" height="10" rx="2" fill="#60c8f0"/>
  
  <!-- Body detail line -->
  <rect x="12" y="52" width="76" height="2" fill="#b81010"/>
  
  <!-- Storage compartments -->
  <rect x="16" y="58" width="18" height="14" rx="1" fill="#c81818"/>
  <rect x="16" y="58" width="18" height="14" rx="1" stroke="#f04040" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  <rect x="38" y="58" width="18" height="14" rx="1" fill="#c81818"/>
  <rect x="38" y="58" width="18" height="14" rx="1" stroke="#f04040" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Compartment handles -->
  <rect x="23" y="63" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffd040"/>
  <rect x="45" y="63" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#ffd040"/>
  
  <!-- Light bar -->
  <rect x="65" y="34" width="18" height="3" rx="1" fill="#ff5050"/>
  <rect x="65" y="34" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#ff2020"/>
  <rect x="75" y="34" width="8" height="3" rx="1" fill="#3080ff"/>
  
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="80" r="10" fill="#282828"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="80" fill="#383838" r="10" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="80" r="6" fill="#606060"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="80" r="3" fill="#888888"/>
  
  <circle cx="70" cy="80" r="10" fill="#282828"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="80" fill="#383838" r="10" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="80" r="6" fill="#606060"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="80" r="3" fill="#888888"/>
  
  <!-- Wheel arches -->
  <path d="M14 76 Q16 68 26 68 Q36 68 38 76" fill="none" stroke="#f04040" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M58 76 Q60 68 70 68 Q80 68 82 76" fill="none" stroke="#f04040" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x="86" y="66" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#c0c0c0"/>
  
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <rect x="86" y="54" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#ffff80"/>
  
  <!-- Hose nozzle at rear -->
  <rect x="8" y="46" width="6" height="3" rx="1" fill="#c0c0c0"/>
  
  <!-- Number plate -->
  <rect x="18" y="74" width="14" height="4" rx="1" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
</svg>
